raw.notable_prerequisites:
Obeka's power is greater than or equal to 8 minus the number of artifacts you control that share a name with the artifact that has Mechanized Production attached.
An opponent cannot block Obeka.
raw.steps:
Deal combat damage using Obeka, triggering Obeka, causing you to get that many upkeep steps after this phase.
Move to your next upkeep step. At the beginning of that step, Mechanized Production triggers, causing you to create a token copy of the artifact it's attached to, and win the game if you control eight or more artifacts that share a name.
Repeat step 2 as necessary for the remaining upkeep steps until you win the game.

raw.notable_prerequisites:
Obeka has power 4 or greater and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You are the monarch.
raw.steps:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Court of Vantress triggers, creating a token copy of Time Sieve.
Deal combat damage using Obeka.
Obeka triggers, causing you to get at least four upkeep steps after this phase.
Repeat step 1 during each of the additional upkeep steps.
Activate the nontoken Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Time Sieve tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

raw.notable_prerequisites: Obeka has power 7 or greater and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
raw.steps:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Replicating Ring triggers, putting a night counter on it. Then, if it has eight or more night counters, remove all of them and create eight Replicating Ring tokens.
Deal combat damage using Obeka. Obeka triggers, causing you to get at least seven upkeep steps after this phase.
Repeat step 1 for each of the additional upkeep steps.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Replicating Ring tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

raw.steps:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Smaug triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Deal combat damage using Obeka, triggering its ability, causing you to get at least four extra upkeep steps.
Repeat step 1 during each extra upkeep step, creating at least four additional Treasures.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Treasures, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
